identity.description: PitchBook: private capital markets data platform offering companies, deals, investors, funds, LPs, and service-provider data, plus an enterprise REST data API and a hosted MCP connector.
identity.identity_notes: The sources describe PitchBook's own API and Claude MCP connector. The official help page and Direct Access page returned HTTP 403, so official-page text was not read directly.

auth.oauth_flows: OAuth applies to the hosted MCP connection (premium.mcp.pitchbook.com) per a search summary, not verified on a fetched page. The REST API uses a static key, not OAuth.
auth.token_refresh: Unknown for the REST API (static key). MCP token refresh not established.

access.production_restrictions: API is a separate offering needing a standalone direct data contract on top of a platform subscription; rate limits are set per contract; not all endpoints are included in every subscription.

read_ops: Search companies, deals, entities, and funds
Get company, deal, investor, fund, limited partner, person, and service provider profiles
Company deals, investors, financials, valuation estimates, similar companies
Deal cap table, participants, and multiples
Bulk read endpoints for companies, funds, investors, people, and others
Account limits, credits history, usage report
api.rate_limits: Not published; set per contract. A 429 response reads '{LIMIT_TYPE} rate limit exceeded.'
api.limitations: Read-only data API as far as sources show; no write operations found. Access is contract-gated, documentation is behind platform login, rate limits are not published, and webhooks are not supported (scheduled data feed delivery instead). Full Composio tool list was truncated, and the PitchBook help and Direct Access pages returned HTTP 403 so were not read directly.

open_questions: The official PitchBook help page (pitchbook.com/help/pitchbook-api) and Direct Access API page returned HTTP 403, so their wording was not checked directly.
Does the hosted MCP require an active PitchBook Premium subscription? The connector page only says 'Sign-in: Required'.
Is the MCP OAuth flow confirmed? Only a search summary supports it.
Are there any community MCP servers on GitHub for PitchBook? Directory listings were found, but no repository was checked.
Is there a trial or free sandbox without a sales contact? Sources say sandbox keys come from the account manager.
What are the full REST endpoint list and exact rate limit values? Documentation is behind platform login.
